name: Christ The High Priest
overview: The Scriptures reveal the priestly role beginning with Melchizedek, who blessed Abram as the priest of the Most High God, symbolizing a priesthood that transcends the Levitical order (Genesis 14:18-20). The consecration of Aaron and his sons with holy garments and anointing at the tabernacle illustrates the Old Testament priestly office and its sacred duties (Exodus 40:12-14). Together, these passages point to a priesthood established by God’s appointment, highlighting Christ as the ultimate High Priest who surpasses Aaron and the Levitical priests in purity, blessing, and divine calling.
